The '''''Cerberus''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] used to deploy [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtroopers]] to the surface of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in search of the stolen data that contained [[Death Star plans/Legends|information]] about the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==Behind the scenes==
In classical [[Wikipedia:Greek mythology|Greek mythology]], [[Wikipedia:Cerberus|Cerberus]] is the name of the three-headed dog belonging to [[Wikipedia:Hades|Hades]] that guarded the entrance to the Underworld.
